name: Destiny HERO - Doom Lord
desc: Once per turn: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; banish that target. You cannot declare an attack the turn you activate this effect. You must control this face-up Attack Position card to activate and to resolve this effect. The banished monster returns to the opponent's field during your 2nd Standby Phase after activation.

name: Destiny HERO - Captain Tenacious
desc: Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: You can target 1 "Destiny HERO" monster in your Graveyard that was destroyed by battle since your last Standby Phase, if you controlled this face-up card when the target was destroyed; Special Summon that target.

name: Destiny HERO - Diamond Dude
desc: Once per turn: You can excavate the top card of your Deck, and if it is a Normal Spell, send it to the GY, otherwise place it on the bottom of your Deck. During the Main Phase of your next turn, you can activate the effect of that Spell in your GY (even if you no longer control this face-up card).

name: Destiny HERO - Dreadmaster
desc: If this card is Special Summoned by "Clock Tower Prison": Destroy all monsters you control, except "Destiny HERO" monsters, also, after that, you can Special Summon up to 2 "Destiny HERO" monsters from your GY. After this card is Special Summoned, for the rest of this turn, "Destiny HERO" monsters you control cannot be destroyed, also you take no battle damage when they battle. The ATK/DEF of this card are equal to the combined original ATK of all other "Destiny HERO" monsters you control.

name: Cyber Tutu
desc: If the ATK of each monster your opponent controls is higher than this card's, this card can attack directly.

name: Cyber Gymnast
desc: Once per turn: You can discard 1 card, then target 1 Attack Position monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.

name: Cyber Prima
desc: If this card is Tribute Summoned: Destroy all face-up Spells on the field.

name: Cyber Kirin
desc: You can Tribute this card to make any effect damage you take this turn 0.

name: Cyber Phoenix
desc: While this card is in Attack Position, negate any Spell/Trap effects that target 1 Machine monster you control (and no other cards). When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can draw 1 card.

name: Searchlightman
desc: FLIP: Your opponent cannot Set (or flip face-down) any cards for the rest of this turn.

name: Victory Viper XX03
desc:
If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: Activate 1 of these effects.
● This card gains 400 ATK.
● Target 1 face-up Spell/Trap on the field; destroy that target.
● Special Summon 1 "Option Token". Its Type, Attribute, Level, and ATK/DEF are always the same as this card, but destroy it if this card is no longer face-up on the field.

name: Swift Birdman Joe
desc: If you Tribute Summon this card by Tributing a WIND monster, return all Spell and Trap Cards on the field to the owners' hands.

name: Harpie's Pet Baby Dragon
desc:
This card gains effects based on the number of "Harpie" monsters you control, except "Harpie's Pet Baby Dragon".
● 1 or more: Your opponent cannot target "Harpie" monsters you control for attacks, except "Harpie's Pet Baby Dragon".
● 2 or more: Double the original ATK and DEF of this card.
● 3 or more: Once per turn: You can target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy that target.

name: Majestic Mech - Senku
desc: When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent by a direct attack: Draw 1 card. During the End Phase of the turn this card was Summoned: Send it to the Graveyard.

name: Majestic Mech - Ohka
desc: You can Normal Summon this card without Tributing. If you do, during the End Phase: Send it to the Graveyard.

name: Majestic Mech - Goryu
desc: You can Tribute Summon (but not Set) this card with 1 Tribute. If Summoned this way, during the End Phase: Send it to the Graveyard. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

name: Royal Knight
desc: When this card destroys a monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard, gain Life Points equal to the DEF of the destroyed monster.

name: Herald of Green Light
desc: When your opponent activates a Spell Card (Quick Effect): You can send this card and 1 other Fairy monster from your hand to the GY; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

name: Herald of Purple Light
desc: When your opponent activates a Trap Card (Quick Effect): You can send this card and 1 other Fairy monster from your hand to the GY; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

name: Bountiful Artemis
desc: Each time a Counter Trap Card is activated, immediately after it resolves, draw 1 card.

name: Layard the Liberator
desc: Each time a Counter Trap Card is activated, immediately after it resolves, add 2 of your banished Fairy monsters to your hand.

name: Banisher of the Radiance
desc: Any card sent to the GY is banished instead.

name: Voltanis the Adjudicator
desc: After 1 of your Counter Trap Cards has been activated and has resolved, you can Tribute all monsters you control to Special Summon this card. If this card is Special Summoned in this way, you can destroy cards your opponent controls up to the number of Fairy-Type monsters you Tributed.

name: Guard Dog
desc: FLIP: Your opponent cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn.

name: Whirlwind Weasel
desc: FLIP: Your opponent cannot activate any Spell or Trap Cards for the rest of this turn.

name: Avalanching Aussa
desc: Once per turn, you can Tribute 1 EARTH monster (except this card) to Special Summon 1 EARTH monster from your hand. The monster Special Summoned by this effect is destroyed if "Avalanching Aussa" is removed from your side of the field.

name: Raging Eria
desc: Once per turn: You can Tribute 1 other WATER monster; Special Summon 1 WATER monster from your hand, but destroy it when a face-up "Raging Eria" you control leaves the field.

name: Blazing Hiita
desc: Once per turn: You can Tribute 1 other FIRE monster; Special Summon 1 FIRE monster from your hand, but destroy it when a face-up "Blazing Hiita" you control leaves the field.

name: Storming Wynn
desc: Once per turn: You can Tribute 1 other WIND monster; Special Summon 1 WIND monster from your hand, but destroy it when a face-up "Storming Wynn" you control leaves the field.

name: Batteryman D
desc: Your opponent cannot select a Thunder-Type monster you control as an attack target (except "Batteryman D").

name: Super-Electromagnetic Voltech Dragon
desc:
If you Tribute Summon this card by Tributing 1 of the following monsters, this card gets the appropriate effect:
● Batteryman D: Negate the effect of a Spell or Trap Card that targets this 1 card.
● Batteryman C: During battle between this attacking card and a Defense Position monster whose DEF is lower than the ATK of this card, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent.
● Batteryman AA: This card gains 1000 ATK.

name: Elemental HERO Phoenix Enforcer
desc:
"Elemental HERO Avian" + "Elemental HERO Burstinatrix"
Must be Fusion Summoned and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. This card cannot be destroyed by battle.

name: Elemental HERO Shining Phoenix Enforcer
desc:
"Elemental HERO Phoenix Enforcer" + "Elemental HERO Sparkman"
Must be Fusion Summoned and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. This card gains 300 ATK for each "Elemental HERO" card in your Graveyard. This card cannot be destroyed by battle.

name: Elemental HERO Mariner
desc:
"Elemental HERO Bubbleman" + "Elemental HERO Avian"
Must be Fusion Summoned. While you have any Set card(s) in your Spell & Trap Zone, this card can attack your opponent directly.

name: Elemental HERO Wild Wingman
desc:
"Elemental HERO Wildheart" + "Elemental HERO Avian"
Must be Fusion Summoned. You can discard 1 card, then target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; destroy that target.

name: Elemental HERO Necroid Shaman
desc:
"Elemental HERO Wildheart" + "Elemental HERO Necroshade"
Must be Fusion Summoned. If this card is Special Summoned: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy that target, then Special Summon 1 monster from your opponent's GY to their field.

name: Misfortune
desc: Select 1 face-up monster your opponent controls. Inflict damage to your opponent equal to half that monster's original ATK. Your monsters cannot attack this turn.

name: H - Heated Heart
desc: Target 1 face-up monster you control; until the end of this turn, it gains 500 ATK, and if it attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

name: E - Emergency Call
desc: Add 1 "Elemental HERO" monster from your Deck to your hand.

name: R - Righteous Justice
desc: Destroy Spells/Traps on the field equal to the number of "Elemental HERO" cards you control.

name: O - Oversoul
desc: Target 1 "Elemental HERO" Normal Monster in your GY; Special Summon that target.

name: Hero Flash!!
desc: Banish "H - Heated Heart", "E - Emergency Call", "R - Righteous Justice" and "O - Oversoul" from your GY; Special Summon 1 "Elemental HERO" Normal Monster from your Deck. All "Elemental HERO" Normal Monsters you currently control can attack your opponent directly this turn.

name: Power Capsule
desc: Select 1 face-up "Victory Viper XX03" you control to activate this card. Select 1 effect of "Victory Viper XX03", and apply it as this card's effect.

name: Celestial Transformation
desc: Special Summon 1 Fairy monster from your hand. That monster's ATK is halved, also it is destroyed during the End Phase.

name: Guard Penalty
desc: Select 1 monster on the field. If it is changed to Defense Position this turn, draw 1 card.

name: Grand Convergence
desc:
If you control "Macro Cosmos": Inflict 300 damage to your opponent, and if you do, destroy all monsters on the field (if any).

* The above text is unofficial and describes the card's functionality in the OCG.

name: Dimensional Fissure
desc: Any monster sent to the GY is banished instead.

name: Clock Tower Prison
desc: Once per turn, during your opponent's Standby Phase: Place 1 Clock Counter on this card. While there are 4 or more Clock Counters on this card, you do not take any battle damage. If this card with 4 or more Clock Counters is destroyed and sent to the GY: Special Summon 1 "Destiny HERO - Dreadmaster" from your hand or Deck.

name: Life Equalizer
desc: Activate only when the difference between both players' Life Points is 8000 or more. Both players' Life Points become 3000.

name: Elemental Recharge
desc: Gain 1000 Life Points for each face-up "Elemental HERO" monster you control.

name: Destruction of Destiny
desc: Send 3 cards from the top of your Deck to the Graveyard, and take 1000 damage for each Spell or Trap Card sent to the Graveyard this way.

name: Destiny Signal
desc: When a monster you control is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower "Destiny HERO" monster from your hand or Deck.

name: D - Time
desc: When a face-up "Elemental HERO" monster you control leaves the field: Add 1 "Destiny HERO" monster from your Deck to your hand whose Level is less than or equal to that "Elemental HERO" monster's original Level.

name: D - Shield
desc: When an Attack Position "Destiny HERO" monster you control is targeted for an attack: Target it; change it to Defense Position and equip it with this card. The equipped monster cannot be destroyed by battle.

name: Icarus Attack
desc: Tribute 1 Winged Beast monster, then target 2 cards on the field; destroy them.

name: Elemental Absorber
desc: Remove from play 1 Monster Card in your hand to activate this card. Your opponent's monsters that have the same Attribute as the monster removed by this effect cannot declare an attack.

name: Macro Cosmos
desc: When this card is activated: You can Special Summon 1 "Helios - The Primordial Sun" from your hand or Deck. While this card is face-up on the field, any card sent to the GY is banished instead.

name: Miraculous Descent
desc: Target 1 of your banished Fairy monsters; Special Summon it. When this card leaves the field, destroy that monster. When that monster is destroyed, destroy this card.

name: Shattered Axe
desc:
Activate this card by targeting 1 face-up monster on the field. During each of your Standby Phases, it loses 500 ATK. When that target is destroyed, destroy this card.

* The above text is unofficial and describes the card's functionality in the OCG.

name: Forced Back
desc: Negate the Normal Summon or Flip Summon of a monster and return it to its owner's hand.
